component.name: Descant
component.summary: A small, fast player for Spotify

description.p: Descant plays your Spotify music in a native GNOME window that starts fast and stays light. No skins, no visualizers, no feeds: your playlists, search and discovery, and music that keeps playing.
Log in by scanning a code with the phone that has Spotify on it. Descant also shows up as a Spotify Connect device, so your phone can control it.

ul.li: Home, search, Liked Songs, albums, artists and your playlists
Picks up where you left off
Keeps playing with the window closed, if you like
Media keys and GNOME's media controls

description.p: Requires Spotify Premium. Descant is not affiliated with Spotify.

ul.li: Home, search, Liked Songs, albums, artists and your playlists
Queue, shuffle, repeat, and picking up where you left off
Spotify Connect, a ten-band equalizer and media controls
